claims.claim_text_verbatim: We propose Residual Advantage (RA), which treats the teacher–student probability residual as a bounded one-step reward, subtracts the corresponding state value under the student policy to form a standard advantage, and centers the result within each response before adding it to the verifier advantage.
claims.claim_summary: Residual Advantage combines bounded teacher residual rewards with verifier advantages.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The guidance term has zero mean within each response, so the verifier advantage remains the response’s mean label and the teacher only redistributes credit among the steps within it.
claims.claim_summary: RA's guidance term maintains zero mean, preserving response-level verifier labels.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Co-RA further updates a teacher LoRA with verifier advantages on the same scored student batch and uses the updated teacher in the next iteration’s residual, adapting guidance to the student’s attempts.
claims.claim_summary: Co-RA adapts teacher guidance by updating a teacher LoRA on student batches.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: With Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base students and a Qwen3-8B teacher, RA combined with GRPO or REINFORCE++ improves the underlying sequence-advantage algorithm in all 24 comparisons on three mathematical benchmarks, raising macro Avg@8 by 1.7–3.6 points and Pass@8 by 3.9–6.3 points.
claims.claim_summary: RA improves base algorithms in all 24 benchmark comparisons across models.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both combinations surpass teacher-only OPD, and Co-RA adds a further 1.0–1.5 Avg@8 points.
claims.claim_summary: RA outperforms teacher-only OPD, and Co-RA provides additional performance gains.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The construction requires no schedule, threshold, or learned component.
claims.claim_summary: RA requires no learned components, thresholds, or training schedules.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Scaled in this way by the student’s own probability, it also stays small wherever the student is already sure, so the teacher mainly adjusts the choices the student is still weighing instead of imposing its preference on those the student has settled, and it does not inflate small disagreements into large labels.
claims.claim_summary: RA scales guidance by student probability, focusing on uncertain student decisions.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: And it is bounded by the student–teacher distance times the probability the student leaves to other tokens, so guidance fades on its own as the two converge.
claims.claim_summary: RA guidance naturally fades as student and teacher distributions converge.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Table 1 contains 24 comparisons of RA with its base estimator (two students, two estimators, three benchmarks, two metrics), and RA improves all 24 three-seed means.
claims.claim_summary: RA improves three-seed benchmark means in all 24 evaluated settings.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: The macro gains are 1.74–3.58 Avg@8 and 3.89–6.33 Pass@8 points (Table 10).
claims.claim_summary: RA provides substantial macro Avg@8 and Pass@8 improvements over baselines.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: GRPO keeps the higher completion accuracy after guidance, but REINFORCE++ with RA has the higher macro Pass@8 at both sizes, a trade between accuracy and coverage that a single score would hide.
claims.claim_summary: RA with REINFORCE++ achieves higher Pass@8 coverage than with GRPO.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both RA combinations exceed teacher-only OPD in macro Avg@8 and Pass@8 at both sizes, by 1.80–2.96 and 2.73–3.90 points (Table 10).
claims.claim_summary: RA combinations outperform teacher-only OPD in both Avg@8 and Pass@8.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In training, OPD also starts more slowly than REINFORCE++ and stays below RA+REINFORCE++ over most of the shared budget (Appendix C).
claims.claim_summary: OPD learns slower and stays below RA+REINFORCE++ during training.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: At the same budget, OPD followed by REINFORCE++ reaches 28.39 and REINFORCE++ with an added reverse-KL loss 26.14, both below RA+REINFORCE++ (Appendix D.5), and sampling the log ratio at the generated token, with the same expected update at each prefix, drops OPD to 24.80 at 1.7B, below verifier-only training (Appendix D.6).
claims.claim_summary: RA+REINFORCE++ outperforms sequential and joint OPD-RL baselines.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Co-RA adds 1.03–1.45 macro Avg@8 points to the four RA runs, and Avg@8 rises in all twelve benchmark means.
claims.claim_summary: Co-RA further raises macro Avg@8 across all benchmark settings.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Co-RA+GRPO is the most accurate run for both students.
claims.claim_summary: Co-RA combined with GRPO achieves highest accuracy for both model sizes.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Yet each adapted teacher scores 0.8–2.3 macro Avg@8 and 0.7–3.5 Pass@8 points below the frozen teacher (Appendix D.9), while the students it guides improve: it is a better guide, not a better solver.

claims.claim_text_verbatim: From K = 8 to K = 512 for the 1.7B REINFORCE++ runs (Appendix D.7), the macro margin of RA over the untrained student grows from 13.4 to 16.9 points, and its margins over REINFORCE++ and OPD from 5.8 to 10.4 and from 3.9 to 6.8, while that of verifier-only training narrows from 7.6 to 6.6, as Yue et al.
